subject: Discovery recap: BrightCart — embeddings & rerank (next steps)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah@brightcart.com>
Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap: BrightCart — embeddings & rerank (next steps)

Hi Sarah — thanks again for taking the time today. I wanted to recap the main points we discussed and propose clear next steps so we can align the POC scope. Short version below, full notes after.

Summary / pain points:
- Search quality drop in product recommendations & site search for long-tail SKUs — current reranking adds significant latency and cost.
- Current stack: Pinecone for vectors (single-region), Postgres for metadata, Python-based nightly batch to upsert new vectors.
- Index scale: ~120M product variants today, with heavy seasonal spikes.
- Patterns: daily full refreshes + incremental hourly batches (~200k changes/hour during peak).
- Success criteria you called out: p95 query latency for rerank < 120ms, baseline relevance lift of +5–8% on NDCG, and cost target under $X per 1M queries.

What we propose for the POC (suggested):
1) 2-week technical POC focusing on latency & cost for reranking workload.
   - Index size: start with 10M vectors (sample subset you provide) and scale to 50M if we hit targets.
   - Model: use a quantized candidate-encoder + lightweight reranker; we’ll test model variants and a trimmed KV-cache to reduce tail latency.
2) Vector stack options to test: Pinecone (your baseline) and an optimized in-house serving path on NVidia A10s with prefix caching.
3) Data & security: we’ll use S3 staging bucket you control + short-lived keys; we can run in your VPC if needed (Private deployment).
4) Metrics & acceptance: p95 latency, p99 tail, cost per 1M queries, and NDCG on your eval set.

Requested from you to get started:
- A 10–50M sample export (IDs + embedding vectors or raw text + instructions to re-run embedding pipeline) and a small labeled eval set (~500 queries)
- Contact for procurement (for a quick PO if POC expands) — you mentioned Tom Alvarez; CC if appropriate.
- Any security questionnaire items or SOC2 evidence we should send upfront (I’ve attached Redwood SOC2 summary).

Next steps / timeline:
- If you confirm, we’ll spin up a 10M POC within 5 business days and schedule a 30-min alignment call to scope data access and VPC needs.
- Lukas will size infra/cost and propose a config; Vivek will draft a POC commercial outline.

Attachments: exec-summary.pdf (POC outline), architecture-diagram.png

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call tomorrow morning if that helps.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

---

(Internal note: cc’ing Lukas and Vivek to keep aligned on sizing and pricing.)

From: Sarah Chen <sarah@brightcart.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: BrightCart — embeddings & rerank (next steps)

Thanks Marissa — this is great and captures the call. A few clarifications and confirmations from our side: 

- Scale: we’re at ~120M product variants; the 10M sample sounds fine to start, but can we include items from each major category so the eval reflects long-tail behavior?
- Patterns: we do hourly incremental updates and one nightly full refresh; peak update rate can hit ~250k vectors/hour during launches.
- Latency target: p95 < 120ms for the full rerank (candidate retrieval + rerank), p99 ideally < 300ms.
- Cost: we’re aiming to not exceed ~$60 per 1M queries for the rerank path (this is a business constraint).

We’re happy to run the POC. Next actions from our side:
- I’ll share a sample export and a small labeled eval set by end of day Friday — attaching BrightCart_requirements.xlsx with data-field notes.
- Procurement: looping in Tom Alvarez (tom.alvarez@brightcart.com) for PO path; Tom, can you advise on a standard PO cadence?
- Security: please send SOC2 + any SOC2 bridge details (we’re okay with the summary you attached but need the bridge doc).

Small ask: can you include an estimate for expected infra spend to run the 10M and 50M runs so my team can budget?

Appreciate it — excited to test Redwood’s optimized serving approach.

Best,

Sarah Chen
Head of Search & Personalization | BrightCart
sarah@brightcart.com

---

Attachment: BrightCart_requirements.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Chen <sarah@brightcart.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Discovery recap: BrightCart — embeddings & rerank (next steps)

Looping you both in with Sarah’s confirmation. Quick internal asks / owners: 

- Lukas: can you draft a POC infra plan + cost estimate for 10M and 50M sample runs (include candidate encoder + reranker, expected GPU types, expected egress/storage costs)? Aim for a one-pager by EOD Friday.
- Vivek: can you put together a minimal commercial outline for a 2-week POC (we should include refundable credits + terms for scaling to Dedicated). Include proposed list price and a discounted POC rate.
- Marissa (me): I’ll schedule the alignment call with Sarah + Tom for Monday and prepare the access instructions (S3 staging + short-lived keys).

Notes from Sarah to keep in mind: p95 < 120ms target, ~120M full index, ~250k changes/hour peak, cost target ~$60/1M queries. They want category-stratified sample + 500 query eval set.

I’ll add a short agenda for Monday’s call and share a calendar invite.

Thanks —
Marissa
